text.p: Rodman & Renshaw Inc said Tuesday it raised sales and earnings estimates for Nordstrom Inc based on strong early sales trends throughout the second week of the retailer's anniversary sale.

Rodman & Renshaw said it estimates July same store sales will show an increase of about three to five percent and raised its estimate for a third quarter same store sales increase to three percent from one percent.
Rodman & Renshaw also said it raised its third quarter earnings estimate for Nordstrom to $0.73 a share from $0.66 and its fiscal 1998 estimate to $2.35 from $2.25.
Rodman & Renshaw repeated a buy recommendation on the retailer's stock and raised its share price target to $68 from $60.
Shares of Nordstrom were trading up 3-5/16 to 56-5/16 on turnover of more than 3.4 million shares.
